integrity: Definitions and reductions were checked from the accessible primary source. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only prime indices for the first numerator, and primes congruent to 3 modulo 4 for the second quotient, are settled.

title: Prime-index irreducibility for two generalized-totient Lambert numerators
